agent_states.description: How far each agent got, by hostname.

chain.description: The calls of other behaviors that the method made on each host, one line for each host, such as web-01: netplan update (changed) → managedfile update (changed).

changed.description: Whether the operation modified system state. Null for pending/failed jobs; true/false for completed jobs.

hostname.description: Agent hostname that processed the job.

operation.description: What the job asked for, with each secret masked.

data.description: The data of the operation, with each secret masked.

responses.description: What each agent answered, by hostname.

steps.description: The calls of other behaviors that the method made on the host, also when one failed.

target.description: The target the request gave: _any, _all, a hostname, or a label such as group:web.dev. A job stored before targets were kept has the host that answered.

timeline.description: Chronological sequence of job lifecycle events.

event.description: Event type (submitted, acknowledged, started, completed, failed, retried).

hostname.description: Agent or source that generated the event.

status_counts.description: Count of all jobs by status (submitted, processing, completed, failed, partial_failure). Derived from key names during the listing pass, with no extra reads.

total_items.description: Total number of jobs matching the filter.

error.description: A description of the error that occurred.

reason.description: Why the request failed, as a word that a program can branch on. The HTTP status is the class of the problem; the reason is the cause, and the error is the message for a person, which can change between releases. invalid_request: the request breaks a rule, such as a missing field (400). unauthorized: no token, or a token that is not valid (401). forbidden: the token does not have the permission (403). not_found: the host or osapi does not have what the request names (404). not_managed: the item is there, but osapi did not deploy it, so osapi does not change it (409). not_installed: the host does not have a program that the request needs (409). conflict: the state of the item blocks the request, such as a create of one that exists (409). unavailable: a part that osapi depends on is down, such as NATS (503). server_error: the controller failed; its log has the cause (500).
